jobs.title: SVP, Product
jobs.description:
SVP, Product

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.

You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.

This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.

Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.

Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

AI and agentic product

  • Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
  • Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
  • Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
  • Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Portfolio and operating model

  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
  • Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
  • Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.

Team and accountability

  • Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
  • Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
  • Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
  • Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
  • Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
  • Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
  • Start collaborating closely with your product teams.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
  • Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
  • Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
  • Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
  • Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
  • Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
  • Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
  • At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
  • At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
  • Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
  • Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
  • Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
  • Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
  • Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
  • Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
  • Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

Full-Time Canada, Europe

jobs.title: AI Mentor (Independent Contractor) - Business Leader Programs
jobs.description:
AI Mentor (Independent Contractor) - Business Leader Programs

About Us

Udacity is now an Accenture company, and exciting things are happening! We are on a mission of forging futures in tech through radical talent transformation in digital technologies. We offer a unique and immersive online learning platform, powering corporate technical training in fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Autonomous Systems, Cloud Computing and more. Our rapidly growing global organization is revolutionizing how the enterprise market bridges the talent shortage and skills gaps during their digital transformation journey.

In our mission toward powering careers through tech education, we are doubling down on the support that we offer to our students. As a part of this, we are looking for experienced AI professionals to mentor learners enrolled in our business-focused AI programs.

Our learners are typically managers, executives, and other senior professionals responsible for AI initiatives inside their organizations. They are working through structured Udacity curriculum and applied projects. Mentors are there to deepen understanding, provide context from real-world experience, and help connect course concepts to how AI is actually deployed.

This is not a purely academic role. We’re looking for practitioners who have actually worked with AI in production environments and can speak candidly about what works, what fails, and why.

Responsibilities:

  • Reinforce and expand on concepts covered in Udacity’s AI business leader programs.
  • Guide learners through Udacity course projects, providing structured, actionable advice.
  • Share practical industry experience on how AI is deployed, managed, and scaled within organizations.
  • Clarify complex AI concepts (e.g., generative models, agentic systems, RAG architectures, model evaluation, governance frameworks) in accessible, business-relevant terms.
  • Discuss how AI decisions are made inside organizations, including trade-offs, constraints, and implementation challenges.
  • Offer grounded perspective on where AI delivers meaningful value and where it is often misapplied.
  • Experience with facilitating structured group sessions for professional audiences is strongly preferred.

You’ll engage with learners who vary in technical fluency, so the ability to adjust your explanations and examples is important.

Required skills/qualifications:

  • 5+ years working in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or AI Product roles.
  • Direct experience deploying AI/ML systems in production environments.
  • Familiarity with generative AI (LLMs, RAG, tool use, evaluation) and/or agent-based systems.
  • Solid understanding of model evaluation and how data quality impacts outcomes.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders or senior leadership.
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly without oversimplifying.
  • Strong communication presence and ability to manage group discussions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience leading AI initiatives inside an organization.
  • Exposure to vendor evaluation or build-vs-buy decisions.
  • A background that spans both technical and business responsibility.

Why should you apply?

Bei uns erlebst du aus nächster Nähe, wie Firmen AI heute tatsächlich einsetzen, sitzt direkt mit am Tisch und packst an, wo es gerade gebraucht wird. In Projekten arbeiten wir mit einem festen Netzwerk aus Entwicklern und Spezialisten zusammen, du bist die erste Festeinstellung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der strategischen Planung und Umsetzung von AI-Projekten, anfangs an klar umrissenen Teilaufgaben, nach ein paar Monaten mit eigener Verantwortung für ganze Projektabschnitte.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du lernst schnell, und das kannst du belegen. Für uns das wichtigste Kriterium. Wir fragen dich nach etwas, das du vor drei Monaten noch nicht konntest.

  • Du hast etwa zwei Jahre Arbeitserfahrung und dabei Themen zu Ende gebracht. Fachrichtung sekundär, Mindset schlägt Fachrichtung.

  • Du hast technisches Grundverständnis, musst aber kein Techie sein. Du kannst einem Geschäftsführer erklären, was ein Tool tut und was nicht.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools und hast damit schon echte Projekte fertig bekommen, nicht nur ausprobiert.

  • Du fragst, statt zu warten, und bringst Vorschläge mit statt offener Fragen.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

  • Auf dich ist Verlass. Unsere Kunden lassen uns tief in ihre Prozesse schauen, dieses Vertrauen braucht es auch zwischen uns.

Was wir bieten

  • 45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung. Unbefristet, 40 Stunden, 6 Monate Probezeit, 28 Urlaubstage.

  • Du sitzt bei den wichtigen Entscheidungen mit am Tisch. Preise, Kunden, Positionierung, wen wir als Nächstes einstellen. Du erlebst aus erster Hand, wie sich eine Firma entwickelt, und du kannst mitschieben.

  • Mac und die AI-Tools, mit denen du am besten arbeitest. Gehört für uns zu guter Arbeit dazu.

  • Verantwortung früh, nicht nach zwei Jahren. Eigene Aufgaben in Projekten nach wenigen Wochen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer. Du lernst an echten Entscheidungen, wie man ein Unternehmen aufbaut, und du siehst, wie AI im Mittelstand wirklich ankommt, nicht in Demos.

  • Vor Ort in Ismaning bei München, teilweise je nach Aufgaben Homeoffice machbar.

  • Sehr direkte Feedback-Kultur, in beide Richtungen.

Deine ersten Wochen

In den ersten zwei Wochen lernst du uns kennen und bekommst die ersten internen und Projektaufgaben. Nach drei Monaten trägst du deine Aufgaben komplett, inklusive Kundenkontakt, zusammen mit dem Gründer.

Wenn du dich eher darauf freust, noch nicht zu wissen, welche Challenge nächste Woche wartet, dann wird es dir hier gefallen.

jobs.title: SENIOR-BERATER (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SENIOR-BERATER (m/w/d)

Managementberatung | Systemische Organisationsberatung | Executive Coaching & Diagnostik

Anspruchsvolle Beratung braucht Persönlichkeit, Urteilskraft und unternehmerisches Denken.

PILLONG steht für anspruchsvolle Personal- und Managementberatung mit einem besonderen Verständnis für Menschen, Führung und Organisationen.

Wir begleiten Unternehmen, Unternehmer, Geschäftsführungen und Führungskräfte bei strategischen Personalentscheidungen, in komplexen Veränderungsprozessen und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Führung und Organisation.

Dabei verbinden wir gewachsene Beratungskompetenz und langjährige Mandantenbeziehungen mit wissenschaftlich fundierten Methoden, systemischer Beratung und der Offenheit für neue technologische Entwicklungen.

So wie wir unsere Mandanten in ihrer Weiterentwicklung begleiten, entwickeln wir auch unser eigenes Beratungsverständnis, unsere Methoden und unser Leistungsangebot kontinuierlich weiter.

Im Rahmen dieser strategischen Weiterentwicklung suchen wir eine erfahrene Beraterpersönlichkeit (m/w/d), die anspruchsvolle Mandate eigenverantwortlich begleitet, neue Beratungsbeziehungen aufbaut und die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitgestaltet.

Ihre Verantwortung

Sie begleiten Unternehmer, Geschäftsführungen und Führungsteams bei strategisch bedeutsamen Fragestellungen und übernehmen Verantwortung für die Konzeption, Durchführung und Weiterentwicklung anspruchsvoller Beratungsmandate.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen insbesondere:

  • Eigenständige Beratung und Begleitung von Geschäftsführungen, Führungskräften und Managementteams in komplexen Entwicklungs- und Veränderungssituationen

  • Konzeption und Durchführung systemischer Organisationsberatungsprojekte, insbesondere zu Führungsstrukturen, Zusammenarbeit, Kultur und Transformation

  • Executive Coaching sowie Moderation anspruchsvoller Führungs- und Entwicklungsprozesse

  • Integration diagnostischer Methoden in die Beurteilung und Entwicklung von Führungspersönlichkeiten und Managementteams

  • Mitwirkung am Ausbau unserer Leistungen in den Bereichen Leadership Assessment, Managementdiagnostik und Executive Development

  • Verbindung von strategischer Personalberatung mit weiterführenden Organisations- und Entwicklungsmandaten

  • Reflektierter Einsatz moderner KI-Anwendungen zur Unterstützung von Analyse, Konzeption und Beratung

  • Eigenständiger Aufbau und nachhaltige Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Mandantenbeziehungen sowie Akquisition neuer Beratungsmandate

Ihr Profil

Wir suchen keine Persönlichkeit, die Beratung ausschließlich als Anwendung erlernter Methoden versteht.

Wir suchen einen Menschen, der über Erfahrung, Haltung und die Fähigkeit verfügt, auch in schwierigen Führungssituationen Orientierung zu geben.

Sie bringen idealerweise mit:

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Sozialwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mehrjährige qualifizierte Berufserfahrung in der Managementberatung, Organisationsentwicklung, Führungskräfteberatung oder in verantwortlicher Managementfunktion

  • Eine fundierte systemische Beratungs- oder Coachingausbildung beziehungsweise vergleichbare methodische Qualifikationen

  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, Unternehmensführung und organisationale Veränderungsprozesse

jobs.title: Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) Voll- oder Teilzeit, Böblingen (hybrid)
jobs.description:
Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) Voll- oder Teilzeit, Böblingen (hybrid)

WORUM ES GEHT

Du übernimmst die Finanzbuchhaltung von Thorit, hands-on und eigenständig. Zusammen mit unserem CFO bist du das Finance-Team: Du buchst selbst, hältst die Zahlen sauber und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Finanzprozesse künftig aussehen.

Wir sind eine AI-Beratung. Was wir bei unseren Kunden automatisieren, wollen wir auch intern umsetzen, und die Finanzbuchhaltung bietet sich dafür besonders an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der sauber bucht und gleichzeitig Lust hat, Abläufe neu zu denken.

Heute liegt ein großer Teil der laufenden Buchhaltung noch bei unserer Steuerkanzlei. Langfristig wollen wir deutlich mehr davon selbst machen. In welchem Tempo und in welcher Reihenfolge, entscheidest du mit.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du buchst eigenständig in DATEV: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Sachkonten und Bankabstimmung

  • Du räumst Altbestände auf und hältst die offenen Posten aktuell

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und machst daraus einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Prozess

  • Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen

  • Du rechnest Reisekosten ab

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Steuerkanzlei und begleitest den Jahresabschluss

  • Du schaust dir unsere Abläufe kritisch an und automatisierst, was sinnvoll ist, zum Beispiel Belegzuordnung, Abstimmungen oder Auswertungen

  • Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben, die heute noch extern laufen

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Finance-Prozesse in Confluence

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Notwendig

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der deutschen Finanzbuchhaltung, sodass du im Tagesgeschäft ohne lange Einarbeitung loslegen kannst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV

  • Solides Wissen im Handels- und Steuerrecht, soweit es die Buchhaltung betrifft

  • Du arbeitest gern eigenständig und triffst Entscheidungen, auch wenn niemand danebensteht

  • Du bist neugierig und eignest dir neue Themen schnell selbst an

  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und AI und willst dich darin weiterentwickeln. Programmierkenntnisse brauchst du nicht.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Arbeitsalltag (unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch, ein Teil des Teams sitzt in Lissabon)

  • Du wohnst im Raum Böblingen und bist regelmäßig im Büro

Schön zu haben

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierung in der Buchhaltung, etwa Bankregeln, Belegmatching, Schnittstellen oder AI-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn und Gehalt (die Abrechnung läuft aktuell extern, ist aber perspektivisch ein Thema)

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresabschlüssen zusammen mit einer externen Kanzlei

  • Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (abgeschlossen oder geplant)

UNSER SETUP

  • WeClapp als führendes System für Rechnungsausgang, Eingangsrechnungen und offene Posten

  • DATEV für die Buchhaltung und den Austausch mit der Kanzlei

  • Qonto für Kontoanbindung und Belegmatching mit DATEV-Schnittstelle

  • TravelPerk für Reisebuchungen

  • Confluence für Dokumentation, Forecast für Zeiterfassung, HubSpot als CRM

  • Claude ist bei uns Standardwerkzeug. Es ersetzt keine Buchhaltung, nimmt dir aber Recherche, Dokumentation und wiederkehrende Fleißarbeit ab.

WAS WIR DIR ZUSAGEN

  • Alle Zugriffe ab Tag 1: Bankvollmachten, System- und Leserechte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CFO und kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung

  • Echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Finance mit auf, statt ein fertiges System zu verwalten

  • Zeit, um Automatisierungen auszuprobieren und dich in AI weiterzubilden

RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

  • Standort: Böblingen, mindestens 2 Bürotage pro Woche

  • Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 25 Std./Woche

  • Start: ab sofort

Was wir bieten

  • Vorsorge & Zuschüsse: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über die Allianz mit gestaffeltem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 50 bis 290 € monatlich, dazu Lunchit-Essenszuschuss von bis zu 100 € monatlich

  • Flexibilität: Bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr Arbeiten von überall in der EU inklusive 500 € Zuschuss, Spaces-Coworking-Mitgliedschaft, flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Business Bike Leasing, Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu über 8.000 Standorten

  • Weiterbildung: Vollzugriff auf die Blinkist-Business-Bibliothek (4.500+ Titel), 3 Monate Babbel, vollständig finanzierte HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Kultur: Flache Hierarchien mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung, moderner Toolstack, Corporate Benefits bei über 800 Marken

Über Thorit

Thorit ist die AI- und CRM-Beratung für das agentische Unternehmen. Als Diamond HubSpot Partner arbeiten wir mit B2B-Kunden im DACH-Markt: Wir bauen die Agenten-Ebene auf HubSpot und den umliegenden Systemen auf – und betreiben sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden. Was wir dort empfehlen, wenden wir auch intern an: weniger Handarbeit, mehr Struktur. Diese Rolle ist ein zentraler Teil davon.

Bewerbung

Schick uns deine Bewerbung – Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist optional.

Wenn du magst, schreib uns ein paar Sätze dazu, wie du schon einmal eine unaufgeräumte Buchhaltung in Ordnung gebracht hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als jede Formulierung im Anschreiben – wir fragen sonst im Gespräch danach.

jobs.title: Senior Development Engineer – Verbindungstechnologie (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Development Engineer – Verbindungstechnologie (m/w/d)

Hochtechnologie und Innovation...

…aktiv mitgestalten und vorantreiben – für diese Position suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit (m/w/d), die mit Ideenreichtum, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und fachlicher Kompetenz überzeugt. Als Beratungsunternehmen unterstützen wir unseren Kunden bei der Suche nach einer passenden Person, die Herausforderungen nicht als Hürde, sondern als spannende Möglichkeit zur Weiterentwicklung versteht.

Das erwartet dich:

  • Entwicklung und Bewertung von Verbindungstechnologien für optische, mechanische und elektrische Schnittstellen komplexer opto-mechatronischer Systeme.

  • Konstruktion und Optimierung von Steckverbindern, Kabeln, Glasfaser- und Hochgeschwindigkeitsverbindungen für anspruchsvolle technische Anwendungen.

  • Bewertung technischer Lösungen hinsichtlich Signalintegrität, Stromintegrität, EMV, Robustheit und Serienfertigungstauglichkeit.

  • Eigenständige Bearbeitung von Entwicklungsprojekten einschließlich Spezifikation, Konstruktion, Verifizierung und Qualifizierung neuer Verbindungssysteme.

  • Abstimmung technischer Anforderungen und Schnittstellen mit internen Fachabteilungen, Lieferanten und externen Entwicklungspartnern.

  • Durchführung technischer Fehleranalysen, Bewertung von Entwicklungsrisiken und Unterstützung interdisziplinärer Teams bei komplexen Problemstellungen.

  • Erstellung und Prüfung technischer Dokumentationen, Spezifikationen, Prüfberichte und Abnahmekriterien zur Validierung neuer Verbindungstechnologien.



Für diese Position sind bestimmte fachliche und persönliche Voraussetzungen hilfreich. Die folgenden Anforderungen geben dir einen Überblick darüber, welche Erfahrungen und Eigenschaften für diese Rolle von Vorteil sind.

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Elektronik, Mechatronik, Optoelektronik, Physik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Verbindungstechnologien, idealerweise im industriellen Hightech-Umfeld.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochgeschwindigkeitsverbindungen, Faseroptik, HF-Technologie sowie Steckverbinder- und Kabelkonstruktion.

  • Erfahrung in der Integration optischer und elektrischer Verbindungssysteme in komplexe elektronische Baugruppen.

  • Kenntnisse in Verifizierung, Qualifizierung und Fehleranalyse einschließlich Umwelt-, Zuverlässigkeits- und Belastungstests.

  • Erfahrung im Spezifikations-, Schnittstellen- und Lieferantenmanagement sowie ausgeprägte technische Kommunikations- und Problemlösungskompetenz.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

jobs.title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)

Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
  • Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.

Mise au point et validation

  • Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
  • Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
  • Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.

Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

  • Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
  • Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).

Vie du laboratoire

  • Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
  • Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.

Requirements

Compétences techniques

  • Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
  • Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
  • Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
  • Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

  • Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
  • Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
  • Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
  • Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
  • Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
  • Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
  • Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.

Benefits

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Public APIs

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


⭐ Mission

Shape how Qonto connects to the rest of its customers' world by building the Public API strategy: a reliable, consistent API that powers integrations, partners, MCP and Qonto Embed, and turns connectivity into a growth engine for our all-in-one and upmarket ambitions. You will report to Fanny, who leads Qonto Connect, and you will own the product and governance framework that every Qonto team builds on.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As Product Manager, Public API, you will:

  • Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next.
  • Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers.
  • Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps.

🤔 What you can expect

  • Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy.
  • Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers.
  • The first question on your desk: what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API.
  • Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job.
  • Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features.

🏅 About you

  • Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself.
  • API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers.
  • Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it.
  • Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto).
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

jobs.title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
jobs.description:
Manager Operations Planning & Performance

Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau.

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen

  • Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse.

  • Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren.

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties (On Time) en kosten (Cost per Drop) en maximaliseert de vulgraad.

  • Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

  • Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving.

  • Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt

  • Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré.

  • Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties.

  • Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.
Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

Think of it as being the first research leader at a fast-growing startup, with the reach and resources of a global platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Player Responsibilities (Individual Contributor Work):

  • Lead mixed-methods research (qualitative and quantitative) that explores user needs, behaviors, and motivations across multiple product areas.

  • Drive foundational studies that reveal how teams collaborate and what barriers exist in business collaboration, hybrid, and distributed work.

  • Design and execute medium to large-scale studies that combine qualitative depth with quantitative rigor (surveys, logs analysis, segmentation, and concept testing).

  • Develop a tempo where actionable insights are timely and urgently positioned to shape key product decisions.

  • Translate ambiguous questions into clear learning plans and frameworks that guide product and strategy decisions.

  • Build artifacts (archetypes, frameworks, journey maps, mental models) that make complex insights accessible and actionable across the company, leveraging Mural products.

  • Present insights to an executive, cross-functional audience and provide strategic recommendations based on these insights.

Coach Responsibilities:

  • Build the research practice: mentor designers, and product partners in research best practices, helping to scale a culture of curiosity and evidence-based decision making.

  • Establish repeatable, high-quality research standards and methodologies across teams.

  • Partner with design and product leadership to shape Mural’s long-term research vision and roadmap.

  • Champion the role of research in early product strategy and company-wide initiatives.

Hybrid Responsibilities (Both Player & Coach):

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders to prioritize research that informs Mural’s most critical next-generation bets.

  • Facilitate workshops and storytelling sessions that bring insights to life and influence direction across product, design, and business strategy.

  • Partner with Data Science and Market Research to integrate behavioral data, attitudinal insights, and business signals into cohesive, actionable narratives.

  • Shape how research connects to strategy, innovation, and experimentation at every level of the company.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 10+ years of UX Research experience, including deep expertise in both qualitative and quantitative methods. PhD optional.

  • Proven track record leading foundational and strategic research that influenced product direction, vision, or long-term investments.

  • Ability to design and execute mixed-methods research independently: from ethnographic and in-depth interviews to survey design and statistical analysis.

  • Scale strategic insights: Experience driving organizational understanding through storytelling, synthesis, and actionable frameworks.

  • Strong systems thinking skills, with an ability to connect human insight to product architecture and long-term design strategy.

  • Experience shaping and scaling research practices in growing organizations.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping cross-functional teams find clarity and alignment.

  • Strong communicator who can engage both executive and hands-on audiences with empathy, clarity, and conviction.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE MURAL

You’ll shape new ways of working, as we interact with AI, team members, and customers. You’ll work on some of the most compelling and open-ended questions about the future of collaboration: how people align, make decisions, and innovate. You’ll have the freedom to define the big questions, run the right studies, and guide the company toward its next horizon.

At Mural, we “drink our own champagne” and leverage our product for online collaboration. This role is U.S. Remote. Your work will inform the strategy of a rapidly scaling company that believes research is the compass, not just the map.

jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager

An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You're joining our Product Marketing team that owns product positioning, launch strategy, and market adoption for Primer's core product lines. We operate as strategic partners embedded in each major domain, working alongside Product and Sales leadership to define how our products win in market. Our PMMs own end-to-end strategy and execution for a significant product area, which means your work gets seen, shaped, and acted on by senior leadership from day one. You'll report to our Product Marketing Lead and work directly with product leads, marketing leads and senior stakeholders across the business.

What will you be doing?

Core Focus: This is an individual contributor (IC) role providing end-to-end product marketing support for our newly built Partners team. This role needs attention to detail, creativity, and boldness to build out the product's market presence.

  • Own the Partner marketing engine: Driving go-to-market launches from strategy to execution, collaborating closely with the broader marketing team.

  • Work with Partner PMs and Commercial Teams to define target audiences and craft clear, compelling messaging and positioning that differentiates Primer's Partner capabilities in the market.

  • Translate technical products into messaging that lands with both partners and the merchants who benefit from them.

  • Synthesise partner and merchant feedback, sales signals, and market research into a coherent strategic perspective that shapes both messaging and GTM approach.

  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of product marketing initiatives, using data to optimise strategies and achieve business goals.

What we're looking for:

Must-haves:

  • 4+ years of B2B SaaS marketing or product marketing experience, , with a track record of launching and growing successful B2B products.

  • Comfort turning technical product detail into messaging a non-technical buyer or partner wants to read.

  • Ability to conduct targeted competitive and buyer research and turn it into specific recommendations.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experiment-minded, taking full ownership of outcomes and driving work with minimal oversight.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Background in payments, fintech, or infrastructure products (or willingness to build that domain knowledge quickly)

  • Creative judgment - you can brief teams and agencies authoritatively and push for sharper, more unexpected ideas

  • Experience marketing in a two-sided marketplace, balancing distinct value propositions for supply-side and demand-side audiences

Why you may not like it here:

  • We move fast. A Tier 1 launch plan that takes months to build is too slow. You'll be making calls on strategy, sequencing, and messaging trade-offs on tighter timelines.

  • All roles at Primer involve hands-on execution to drive maximum impact. If you want to set direction and hand off delivery to someone else, this might not be the fit.

  • You'll work alongside sharp, opinionated stakeholders in sales and product who will pressure-test your ideas. The best PMMs here treat that pushback as a chance to sharpen their thinking with data, not as a hurdle to clear before moving on.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

💰 Competitive share options

🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role

jobs.title: Director, Portfolio Management (Mozilla.org)
jobs.description:
Director, Portfolio Management (Mozilla.org)

About Mozilla.org

Mozilla is a mission-driven portfolio of companies and organizations working together to shape an internet that serves people and the public good.

Currently, this portfolio includes: the Mozilla Foundation, which champions our mission through philanthropic risk capital; Mozilla Corporation, which makes Firefox; MZLA, which makes Thunderbird; Mozilla Ventures, which invests in responsible tech startups; Mozilla.ai, which creates open source AI developer tools; Mozilla Data Collective, a data sharing platform for human agency and fair value exchange. It also includes a handful of smaller strategic investments and Mozilla's investment reserve.

Mozilla.org serves as a steward of this portfolio, managing Mozilla's assets and investments to ensure they are used to advance the vision outlined in the Mozilla Manifesto. In this role, it shapes long term strategy, allocates funding and manages Mozilla’s brands. Ultimately, its job is to enable the success of all of Mozilla’s organizations in the pursuit of the overall nonprofit mission. Over the coming years, our ambition is to actively grow the portfolio—helping existing organizations grow and mature while creating or investing in new organizations that can extend Mozilla’s reach and build long-term financial value.

About the Role

As a part of the Mozilla.org team, the Director, Portfolio Management sits at the intersection of portfolio planning, governance, performance management, and cross-organizational execution. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for an operator who can bring structure to complexity, translate portfolio priorities into clear plans and processes, and ensure leaders across Mozilla have the information, forums, and operating rhythms needed to make effective decisions.

The role reports directly to Mozilla’s COO and, along with everyone on the Mozilla.org team, is housed within the Mozilla Management Company.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Planning & Performance

  • Lead the portfolio planning process, integrating organizational strategies, operating plans, capital requirements and portfolio-level priorities. This includes double bottom line goal setting and capital allocation across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations.
  • Develop and maintain the information architecture for portfolio management, including portfolio-level dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide visibility into organizational priorities, performance, risks, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Finance and operating organization leaders to connect strategic priorities, operating plans, and resource allocation.
  • Develop comparative analyses, benchmarks and portfolio insights. Identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention.
  • Synthesize information across the portfolio into clear insights, recommendations, and decision points for Mozilla.org leadership.

Portfolio Governance & Operating Model

  • Maintain and evolve operating frameworks, decision rights, authority matrices, and playbooks that clarify how Mozilla.org, and portfolio organizations work together.
  • Serve as a systems thinker — constantly looking to optimize the interface between strategic ambition and operational muscle.
  • Coordinate portfolio governance processes and help prepare materials for leadership and Board discussions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve decision-making, and reduce unnecessary coordination across organizations.

Cross-Portfolio Execution

  • Lead or coordinate high-priority initiatives that span multiple Mozilla organizations.
  • Translate Mozilla.org portfolio priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, and delivery cadences.
  • Surface risks and execution gaps early and work with leaders across the portfolio to resolve them.
  • Build lightweight processes that create accountability without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

Leadership & Decision Support

  • Serve as a strategic and operational partner to the COO and broader Mozilla.org leadership team.
  • Design and facilitate portfolio-level operating forums and working sessions.
  • Build trusted relationships across Mozilla’s portfolio organizations and influence effectively without relying on direct authority.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a multi-entity holding company or an investment management, private equity, venture capital, or development finance organization.
  • Direct prior experience in a portfolio-level role, along with experience in strategy, business operations, portfolio operations, strategic program management, or related roles.
  • A strong connection to Mozilla’s mission and an interest in helping build an organizational model that combines mission impact with strong operational and business discipline.
  • Familiarity with Board governance and capital allocation processes strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Expertise in managing qualitative and quantitative metrics tracking, dashboards, and systems thinking.
  • Experience leading significant cross-functional initiatives involving senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level materials.
  • Strong judgment and discretion when working with sensitive organizational and leadership topics.
  • Ability to operate effectively in environments with distributed decision-making and significant stakeholder complexity.

What Success Looks Like

You help Mozilla.org provide an effective management and coordination layer across the Mozilla portfolio. Leaders across Mozilla understand priorities, decision rights, performance, and dependencies; portfolio-level decisions are supported by useful data and analysis; and important cross-organizational initiatives move from strategy into execution with clear ownership and accountability.

Ultimately, your work helps Mozilla.org more effectively steward its organizations, resources, and mission over the long term.

The Target Annual Base Salary and Pay Range for this role is between $240,000-$280,000 USD.

Additionally, this role is eligible for an Annual Bonus.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - EU
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager - EU

Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

  • Improve how we generate and simulate data in demo accounts. It’s a project off the critical path, but it helps you keep up-to-date on our codebase while immensely impacting the business, from Engineering to QA to Sales.

Why be a manager?

I had two experiences early in my career that set me on my path. I had a great manager who asked tonnes of questions about the decisions I was making and coached me without me realizing it. And I had a terrible manager - being told to work harder after a week of 3am finishes was not what I needed as a young engineer. The stark difference between these two experiences motivated me to become a manager: I wanted every engineer I worked with to have the support I had in the best case.

Since then, as I’ve learned more, I’ve realized that I love the kind of problems I get to solve as a manager. Deeply complex problems with long-term impact both on the company and on people’s lives. One of my proudest achievements is creating a fully transparent pay system, and on the day it was revealed, everybody was happy with it. Nobody stormed out. By spending time thinking deeply about everybody’s pay and ensuring the mechanics of promotion were clear, I put the team in a place where they could see a peer was paid more than them, and it not be a problem.

Despite all this, I love being technical. I sometimes indulge myself and spend a morning writing some code to improve tests or provide better abstractions. If I couldn’t be a manager, I’d be super happy to be an IC.

I’m looking for someone who is passionate. Passionate about both management and being technical. Someone who spots a pattern amongst their team, figures out a better way for us to operate, and then builds the automation that powers it. I introduced a new process that enables engineers to merge 30% of PRs without a human review beforehand. I also built the automation that approves these PRs. I also built that automation with abstractions that make it easy for the engineers to improve the automation themselves.

It can be hard to find seasoned engineering leaders who haven’t succumbed to the status quo in some way or another. We're committed to giving all our people a total and utter lack of terrible managers, and that means we're willing to take a chance on someone early in their leadership journey who's courageous, principled, and has the drive to build themselves into a great leader who can say “Yah I know everyone is doing that, but we won't because...”

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Engineering leadership comes in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. I thought I’d outline some things I’m looking for to help you decide if this fits what you’re looking for:

  • You love being technical and can hold in-depth conversations with direct reports from infra to backend to frontend.

  • You enjoy management problems. We want people who get excited about driving people to be their best, giving difficult feedback, and building systems that make this easier

  • You hold your team to a high standard and don’t shy away from getting into the details and giving feedback, even to the best folks on your team.

  • You are an excellent and empathetic communicator. Facilitating change at both an individual and organization level requires understanding how to navigate the beliefs, opinions, and past experiences of engineers and figuring out how to both convince them of a new way of doing things while also leaving yourself open to feedback.

  • You know what exceptional engineers look like. You’ve thought deeply about what makes them tick, how to recruit them, and how to grow folks into them. I want to see depth here, the industry often regurgitates a vanilla description, but the reality is more nuanced.

  • You’re good at thinking about product, business, and maybe even design, but you’re not interested in calling the shots and are more interested in building a team that can make the best decisions without you.

  • You thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments. We're a young startup where leaders wear multiple hats, and you'll build your own (high-speed) on-ramp through developing strong feedback loops.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if:

  • You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology.

  • You’ve gotten into management because it was the only growth path available

  • You want to make all the product decisions instead of empowering your team to make those calls.

  • You're happy with a team of engineers that are predominantly early-career, mid-career, or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. With enough guardrails, the team can get things done.

  • A staff or principal engineer to you is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews.

  • You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently than the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent product delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers.

What We’re Building

Talent teams aspire to build a hiring process that identifies great candidates, moves them quickly through the interview process, and provides an excellent experience for the candidate. To accomplish this, recruiters perform thousands of daily tasks to coordinate and relay information between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers. Teams struggle to keep up!

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example of our customers' challenges. A recruiter needs to collect availability from the candidate, identify potential interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and perform any last-minute adjustments as availability changes. They must perform this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others.

Ashby provides talent teams with intelligent and powerful software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered and extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Abhik and Benji’s (our co-founders) belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural, Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers can focus 36h out of a 40h work week (Abhik wrote about it here). Even managers can rely on getting consistent time (and support to make, if necessary) to focus and do creative work without the demand of constant meetings.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 5x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience

  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video on it here).

  • AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here.

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy

We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. All of us in technical leadership did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end-user and the business and ownership over the solution. Our engineering culture reflects this experience: engineers own projects end-to-end, from speaking with users to writing product specs to UX design. These are skills that we often don’t get to practice as engineers, and, as a manager at Ashby, you’ll provide mentorship and feedback to engineers to ensure they are successful when delivering projects.

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. As the father of two young girls, I want to see them grow up in a world where all industries are open and welcoming to everyone, regardless of race, gender, or preferences. Helping to build a more diverse team at Ashby is my way of contributing to this change.

Today, 26% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together. Our interview process is six interviews in the following order:

  1. Intro Call (30m) - Discuss your application questions, align on the responsibilities of the role, and answer questions about Ashby.

  2. Past Experience Deep Dive (1h) - Discuss your past experience as an engineering leader.

  3. Technical Screen (1h) - Add a feature back to Ashby. You'll spend most of your time understanding a specific part of our codebase and write less than 15 lines of code.

  4. Coffee Chat with VP of Engineering (1h) - Spend time with our VP of Engineering and get to know each other.

  5. Meet the Team (2h) - At this point, the engineering leadership team is excited about you and you'll meet our CEO, Engineers, Product Managers, and some other folks on the team.

I will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Technology Stack

I’m sharing our tech stack with the caveat that we don’t require previous experience: TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby - do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Responsibilities
